AMP Support

AMP support is removed, including the next/amp import, the amp config and the pages amp config export.

old: import { useAmp } from 'next/amp'
new: no AMP API

devIndicators Options

devIndicators options appIsrStatus, buildActivity and buildActivityPosition are removed.

old: devIndicators.buildActivity
new: the remaining devIndicators indicator

<!-- do not edit; generated from pack v0.3.0 -->

# nextjs-upgrade 15

- `next/async-cookies` (changed_behavior): cookies() is async
- `next/async-draft-mode` (changed_behavior): draftMode() is async
- `next/async-headers` (changed_behavior): headers() is async
- `next/async-params` (changed_behavior): params is a Promise
- `next/async-request-ip` (removed): NextRequest.ip is removed
- `next/async-search-params` (changed_behavior): searchParams is a Promise
- `next/bundlepagesrouterdependencies` (renamed): bundlePagesRouterDependencies
- `next/nextrequest-geolocation` (removed): NextRequest Geolocation
- `next/react-19` (peer_requirement): App Router requires React 19
- `next/route-handlers` (changed_default): Route Handlers
- `next/runtime-configuration-breaking-change` (removed): runtime configuration (Breaking change)
- `next/serverexternalpackages` (renamed): serverExternalPackages

unstable_rootParams

unstable_rootParams is removed. Use next/root-params.

old: unstable_rootParams from next/server
new: next/root-params

cacheLife and cacheTag

unstable_cacheLife and unstable_cacheTag are stable; drop the unstable_ prefix.

old: unstable_cacheLife and unstable_cacheTag
new: cacheLife and cacheTag

next/legacy/image Component (deprecated)

next/legacy/image is deprecated.

old: import Image from 'next/legacy/image'
new: import Image from 'next/image'

revalidateTag

revalidateTag now requires a cacheLife profile as its second argument. The one-argument form is deprecated.

old: revalidateTag('posts')
new: revalidateTag('posts', 'max')

images.domains Configuration (deprecated)

images.domains is deprecated in favour of images.remotePatterns.

old: images.domains
new: images.remotePatterns

headers() is async

headers() from next/headers is asynchronous.

old: const headersList = headers()
new: const headersList = await headers()

cookies() is async

cookies() from next/headers is asynchronous. A synchronous call warns, and the warning becomes an error in 16.

old: const cookieStore = cookies()
new: const cookieStore = await cookies()

searchParams is a Promise

searchParams in page props is a Promise.

old: const { q } = searchParams
new: const { q } = await searchParams

<!-- do not edit; generated from pack v0.3.0 -->

# Codemods

- `next-codemod:app-dir-runtime-config-experimental-edge`: next/runtime-configuration-breaking-change
- `next-codemod:built-in-next-font`: next/the-next-font-package-has-been-fully-removed-in-favor-of-the
- `next-codemod:metadata-to-viewport-export`: no reviewed rule names it
- `next-codemod:middleware-to-proxy`: next/middleware-to-proxy
- `next-codemod:next-async-request-api`: next/async-cookies, next/async-draft-mode, next/async-headers, next/async-params, next/async-search-params
- `next-codemod:next-lint-to-eslint-cli`: next/next-lint-command
- `next-codemod:next-og-import`: no reviewed rule names it
- `next-codemod:next-request-geo-ip`: next/async-request-ip, next/nextrequest-geolocation
- `next-codemod:remove-experimental-ppr`: no reviewed rule names it
- `next-codemod:remove-unstable-prefix`: next/cachelife-and-cachetag
- `next-codemod:upgrade`: no reviewed rule names it
- `react-codemod:migration-recipe-19`: no reviewed rule names it
- `react-codemod:prop-types-typescript`: no reviewed rule names it
- `react-codemod:replace-act-import`: react/removed-react-dom-test-utils
- `react-codemod:replace-reactdom-render`: react/removed-reactdom-hydrate, react/removed-reactdom-render, react/removed-unmountcomponentatnode
- `react-codemod:replace-string-ref`: react/removed-string-refs
- `react-codemod:replace-use-form-state`: no reviewed rule names it
- `types-react-codemod:no-implicit-ref-callback-return`: no reviewed rule names it
- `types-react-codemod:preset-19`: react/the-jsx-namespace-in-typescript
- `types-react-codemod:refobject-defaults`: react/useref-requires-an-argument

Sass node_modules imports

Turbopack does not support the tilde prefix on Sass imports.

old: @import '~bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css'
new: @import 'bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css'

middleware to proxy

The middleware file is deprecated and renamed to proxy. The edge runtime is not supported in proxy.

old: middleware.ts
new: proxy.ts

experimental.dynamicIO and experimental.useCache

experimental.dynamicIO and experimental.useCache are removed. cacheComponents is the replacement, and it is not a rename-only change.

old: experimental.useCache
new: cacheComponents, after adopting the Cache Components model

params is a Promise

params in page, layout and route props is a Promise.

old: const { slug } = params
new: const { slug } = await params

draftMode() is async

draftMode() from next/headers is asynchronous.

old: const { isEnabled } = draftMode()
new: const { isEnabled } = await draftMode()

# react changes

- `react/removed-legacy-context-using-contexttypes-and-getchildcontex` (19, removed): Removed: Legacy Context using contextTypes and getChildContext
- `react/removed-proptypes-and-defaultprops-for-functions` (19, removed): Removed: propTypes and defaultProps for functions
- `react/removed-react-createfactory` (19, removed): Removed: React.createFactory
- `react/removed-react-dom-test-utils` (19, removed): Removed: react-dom/test-utils
- `react/removed-react-test-renderer-shallow` (19, removed): Removed: react-test-renderer/shallow
- `react/removed-reactdom-finddomnode` (19, removed): Removed: ReactDOM.findDOMNode
- `react/removed-reactdom-hydrate` (19, removed): Removed: ReactDOM.hydrate
- `react/removed-reactdom-render` (19, removed): Removed: ReactDOM.render
- `react/removed-string-refs` (19, removed): Removed: string refs
- `react/removed-unmountcomponentatnode` (19, removed): Removed: unmountComponentAtNode
- `react/the-jsx-namespace-in-typescript` (19, removed): The JSX namespace in TypeScript
- `react/useref-requires-an-argument` (19, changed_behavior): useRef requires an argument

# nextjs-upgrade 16

- `next/amp-support` (removed): AMP Support
- `next/cachelife-and-cachetag` (renamed): cacheLife and cacheTag
- `next/devindicators-options` (removed): devIndicators Options
- `next/experimental-dynamicio-and-experimental-usecache` (removed): experimental.dynamicIO and experimental.useCache
- `next/images-domains-configuration-deprecated` (deprecated): images.domains Configuration (deprecated)
- `next/middleware-to-proxy` (deprecated): middleware to proxy
- `next/next-legacy-image-component-deprecated` (deprecated): next/legacy/image Component (deprecated)
- `next/next-lint-command` (removed): next lint Command
- `next/parallel-routes-default-js-requirement` (changed_behavior): Parallel Routes default.js requirement
- `next/revalidatetag` (changed_behavior): revalidateTag
- `next/runtime-configuration` (removed): Runtime Configuration
- `next/sass-node-modules-imports` (removed): Sass node_modules imports
- `next/unstable-rootparams` (removed): unstable_rootParams

next lint Command

The next lint command is removed. Use ESLint or Biome directly. next build no longer runs lint.

old: next lint
new: the ESLint CLI

Parallel Routes default.js requirement

Every parallel route slot needs an explicit default.js. The build fails without it.

old: a parallel slot with no default file
new: default.js that calls notFound() or returns null

Runtime Configuration

serverRuntimeConfig and publicRuntimeConfig are removed. Use environment variables.

old: publicRuntimeConfig
new: an environment variable, with the NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix when the client reads it
